description: This file defines the HoverHUDController class responsible for managing a hover-only heads-up display (HUD) panel anchored to the menu bar item in a macOS app. It includes logic for showing, dismissing, and updating the HUD, as well as a SwiftUI view for the HUD's content.

classes.name: HoverHUDController
classes.description: A singleton class managing the lifecycle, presentation, and dismissal of a hover HUD window in a macOS application, including hover detection and interaction with the WebChatManager.

methods.name: setSuppressed
methods.description: Sets whether the HUD is suppressed (hidden) and cancels/dismisses as needed.

methods.name: statusItemHoverChanged
methods.description: Handles hover state changes over the status item, scheduling display of the HUD if hovered inside.

methods.name: panelHoverChanged
methods.description: Responds to hover state changes over the HUD panel itself, scheduling dismissal when hover exits.

methods.name: openChat
methods.description: Opens the chat panel linked to the HUD, dismissing the current HUD display.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Dismisses the HUD with an optional reason, animating out if visible.

methods.name: scheduleDismiss
methods.description: Schedules the dismissal of the HUD after a delay if not hovered.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Presents (shows) the HUD window, creating it if needed, positioning it relative to anchor, and animating in.

methods.name: ensureWindow
methods.description: Creates the window (NSPanel) and hosting view if not already existing.

methods.name: targetFrame
methods.description: Calculates the target frame for the HUD window based on anchor position or default top-right position.

methods.name: updateWindowFrame
methods.description: Updates the window frame position with optional animation based on target frame.

methods.name: installDismissMonitor
methods.description: Installs global mouse event monitor to dismiss HUD when clicking outside.

methods.name: removeDismissMonitor
methods.description: Removes the global event monitor for dismissal.
